statement: In $\triangle ABC$, excircle $\omega_a$ touches $AB$ at $P$ and $AC$ at $Q$; excircle $\omega_b$ touches $BA$ at $M$ and $BC$ at $N$. Let $K$ be the projection of $C$ onto $MN$ and $L$ the projection of $C$ onto $PQ$. Show $MKLP$ is cyclic.
Find all positive integers $x, y, z$ with $x^5 + 4y = 2013^z$.
Find all $f : \mathbb{R}_{>0}^3 \to \mathbb{R}_{>0}$ satisfying for all $x, y, z, k > 0$: (a) $xf(x,y,z) = zf(z,y,x)$; (b) $f(x,ky,k^2z) = kf(x,y,z)$; (c) $f(1,k,k+1) = k+1$.

In a competition, $n \geq 3$ competitors $A_1, \ldots, A_n$ form a \textit{weakly-friendly cycle} if $A_i$ and $A_{i+1}$ are not friends for $1 \leq i \leq n$ (indices mod $n$), and no other non-friend pairs exist in the cycle. Suppose: for every competitor $C$ and every weakly-friendly cycle $S$ not including $C$, at most one member of $S$ is not a friend of $C$. Prove all competitors can be arranged into three rooms so that any two in the same room are friends.
